title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: Procedure for authenticating and authorizing a UE for a specific network slice (S-NSSAI).

entities.name: UE-initiated de-registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to de-register from the network.

entities.name: NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by AMF to initiate network slice-specific authentication and authorization.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate de-registration procedure.

entities.name: T3575
entities.description: Timer used for retransmission of NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.

entities.name: Lower layers indication of non-delivered NAS PDU due to handover
entities.description: Condition where NAS PDU cannot be delivered due to intra AMF handover.

entities.name: Network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure and de-registration procedure collision
entities.description: Condition where DEREGISTRATION REQUEST is received while network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure is ongoing.

entities.name: AMF aborts network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: AMF behavior to abort the network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure.

entities.name: AMF retransmits NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND
entities.description: AMF behavior to retransmit the NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.

relations.description: Network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure involves sending NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.
Network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure starts timer T3575.
Network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure resets timer T3575 on retransmission.
Timer T3575 expiry triggers retransmission of NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.
Fifth expiry of timer T3575 triggers abortion of network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure.
Handover non-delivery condition establishes retransmission of NETWORK SLICE-SPECIFIC AUTHENTICATION COMMAND message.
Procedure collision condition establishes abortion of network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure.
Procedure collision condition establishes progression of UE-initiated de-registration procedure.
UE-initiated de-registration procedure involves receiving DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message.
